lids.name: Lid stack
lids.say: 9 ft of lids, dropped one per can

bowl.name: Product bowl and CO2 lines
bowl.say: beer and CO2 feed the three heads

heads.name: Fill-head carriage and lift
heads.say: three heads purge with CO2, then fill; the cylinder lowers them

nitro.name: Nitrodoser and LN2 dewar
nitro.say: a drop of liquid nitrogen before the lid

seamer.name: Seamer
seamer.say: chuck, first and second operation rolls

conveyor.name: Infeed and machine conveyor
conveyor.say: carries cans under the heads and seamer

deck.name: Deck, lid mast and seamer lift
deck.say: the lift cylinder raises each can into the seamer chuck

frame.name: Frame and cabinet
frame.say: valves, solenoids and air regulators live in the cabinet
